Shoom is an AI music and video generator that turns your ideas into songs and music videos. Create original songs with your own style, sound, and lyrics, then add your photo to generate personalized AI music videos.

An easier alternative to complex production tools, this AI music maker works for everyone, whether you're a complete beginner or a musician pushing past a creative block. From quick song demos and background tracks to pure creative exploration, Shoom puts music creation right into your hands.

With Shoom, you can:
— Turn a text prompt into a complete vocal or instrumental AI song in minutes.
— Write lyrics or use the built-in lyric generator to craft words to fit your track.
— Record or upload your voice and transform it into unique AI music.
— Reimagine songs with an AI Cover and hear them with fresh new voices.
— Create personalized AI music videos using your photos and favorite Shoom songs.

KEY FEATURES


● DESCRIBE IT, HEAR IT
Type a title, choose a genre, set the mood, and let Shoom handle the rest. From rap and classical to K-pop and rock—this AI music maker supports a wide range of genres, vibes, and atmospheres. 

● BRING YOUR LYRICS TO LIFE
Got lyrics but no melody? Paste your words into the AI song writer and hear them come alive with vocals, instruments, and full production—or generate lyrics instantly and edit them to fit your vision.

● MAKE MUSIC WITH YOUR VOICE
Speak, sing, or hum—Voice Mode turns recordings into AI-generated songs with their own unique sound. Record live or upload audio, and Shoom will build the music around your voice.

● TURN PHOTOS INTO AI MUSIC VIDEOS
Upload your photo, choose a background and a song, and watch them come together as a custom AI music video. Create unique music videos inspired by any genre, mood, or style you love.


● COVER IT YOUR WAY
Reimagine your favorite tracks on the fly. Create an AI cover with a fresh vocal style and discover a whole new energy in a song you already love.

● SAVE IT, KEEP IT, GET IT
All your AI songs, all in one place—everything stays saved and ready to go. Play tracks anytime and download them to share your AI music with friends and family.

HOW DOES SHOOM WORK?
1. Pick a genre and describe the sound you want.
2. Add your own lyrics or let the AI song maker create them from scratch.
3. Enter a title for your track.
4. Tap generate, and your track will be ready in minutes.
5. Listen, download, and share with anyone.

Start making AI music that sounds like you. Download Shoom and turn your next idea into a song.

FAQ
Q: Is Shoom beginner-friendly?
A: Yes. This AI music maker is built so anyone can create a song on their first try—the whole process takes a couple of minutes and requires zero musical background.

Q: What genres are supported?
A: Pop, rock, rap, R&B, classical, indie, jazz, EDM, country, reggae, and more. Every AI song you make can be shaped to match the genre and mood you have in mind.

Q: What makes Shoom different?
A: Shoom is an AI music generator built around simplicity—just describe what you want to hear, and the app will handle the production, arrangement, and mixing for you.

Q: Can I make a music video starring myself?
A: Sure! Upload a photo, choose a background, and pair it with your favorite AI-generated song. Shoom will turn it into a personalized AI music video you can watch, download, and share.

Subscribe to Shoom Premium to generate more AI music and songs.

Subscriptions are billed automatically at the rate depending on the selected subscription plan. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
